title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Logistic Roles - Driver
description: Someone who drives a vehicle (simple-lr:Driver, SIMPLE extension to the FEDeRATED Logistic Roles ontology, subclass of LogisticServiceProvider). Referenced as the range of simple-bs:involvedDriver in the sibling simple-federated-businessservice candidate's TransportService entity.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Driver'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable label (rdfs:label in the source: 'Driver' / 'Conductor').

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
